evidence.title: Signal Intelligence product and data-model specification
evidence.description_public: Defines the operating loop, evidence states, schemas, privacy rules, and review criteria used by this page.

evidence.title: AMD operating mechanisms — portfolio evidence
evidence.description_public: Public portfolio content describes structured triage, Debug Steering and P1 cadences, Jira/Qtest/Power BI controls, root-cause work, corrective action, and verification-oriented program rhythms.

evidence.title: OCI source-of-truth and readiness mechanisms — portfolio evidence
evidence.description_public: Public portfolio content describes governed hardware facts, evidence provenance, readiness controls, data-quality checks, infrastructure constraints, and cross-functional decision mechanisms.

evidence.title: Zscaler Sr. Staff TPM — Service Health role concepts
evidence.description_public: Public role reference for Service Health, CUJ, Lighthouse signal, SLI/SLO, continuous measurement, incident, RCA, preventive-action, and operating-cadence mechanisms.

evidence.title: Anonymized application-tracker snapshot
evidence.description_public: A read-only, 52-row active-pipeline snapshot. Public rendering retains aggregate counts, generic role families, dates, stages, and evidence-quality flags while removing names, requisition IDs, contacts, notes, and private links.

evidence.title: Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange operating sequence
evidence.description_public: Official Zscaler platform overview describes a sequence of verifying identity, determining destination, assessing risk from context, and enforcing policy per session.

evidence.title: Zscaler Digital Experience — end-to-end telemetry
evidence.description_public: Official ZDX overview describes end-to-end visibility across device health, network path, applications, synthetic monitoring, real-user journeys, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis.

evidence.title: ZDX alert thresholds and operational response
evidence.description_public: Official ZDX help documents configurable alert rules triggered by preset thresholds for device, application, network-performance, and experience-score events.

evidence.title: ZDX Network Intelligence anomaly model
evidence.description_public: Official ZDX help describes baselining latency and packet loss, detecting anomalies, assessing impact, and investigating root causes across the path from ISP through Zero Trust Exchange to applications.

evidence.title: LinkedIn market-signal peak snapshot
evidence.description_public: Public-safe aggregate snapshot: 21,136 impressions, 11,810 members reached, 83% out-of-network impressions, 143 social engagements, 95 new followers, and a 997-view weekly profile bucket. This is a visibility peak, not proof of hiring conversion.

system_stages.name: Signals
system_stages.transformation: Timestamp, classify, and preserve source context

system_stages.name: Source of Truth
system_stages.transformation: Resolve entities, validate fields, link evidence, apply privacy controls
system_stages.output: Governed events, journeys, and evidence objects

system_stages.name: Health
system_stages.transformation: Calculate freshness, latency, completeness, and contradictions

system_stages.name: Intelligence
system_stages.input: Health state plus supporting and contradicting signals
system_stages.transformation: Weight evidence, expose uncertainty, freeze a falsifiable forecast
system_stages.output: Forecast window, confidence band, and change conditions

system_stages.name: Decision
system_stages.transformation: Frame tradeoffs, owner, rationale, and next action
system_stages.output: Act, monitor, investigate, escalate, close, or recalibrate

system_stages.name: Verification

system_stages.output: Outcome record, calibration note, and preventive action

forecasts.target_event: At least one direct recruiter or hiring-stage event across the active portfolio
forecasts.rationale: The visibility peak coincided with 32 confirmed applications and one interview-stage journey, but content-to-recruiter attribution was incomplete.
forecasts.change_condition: A dated direct conversation or stage change verifies the forecast; visibility metrics alone do not.
forecasts.replay_note: Retrospective replay frozen to the peak snapshot; not evidence that the forecast was prospectively recorded on Sep 19.

forecasts.target_event: At least one warm-path journey records a direct response or stage update
forecasts.rationale: The snapshot recommended following existing warm introductions, while same-person attribution remained incomplete.
forecasts.change_condition: A source-linked reply or stage event verifies the forecast; inferred interest does not.
forecasts.replay_note: Retrospective replay frozen to the peak snapshot.

forecasts.rationale: Reach was high, but only 11 link visits were recorded and no dated recruiter conversation was tied to a post or profile visit.
forecasts.change_condition: A source-linked recruiter conversation tied to the visibility window would raise confidence.
forecasts.replay_note: Retrospective replay frozen to the peak snapshot.

forecast_outcomes.calibration_note: A direct stage event occurred inside the frozen window. This is one retrospective replay and is not a statistically meaningful calibration result.

anomalies.description: 18 of 52 active records have a follow-up date due on or before the snapshot date.
anomalies.immediate_action: Triage high-priority and direct-engagement journeys first.
anomalies.most_supported_explanation: The pipeline expanded faster than dated follow-up coverage.
anomalies.competing_explanations: Some records may intentionally be monitor-only despite a historical due date.
anomalies.preventive_action: Require a current decision state when a follow-up date passes.
anomalies.verification: Recompute the queue after the next tracker refresh.

anomalies.description: One journey is marked needs confirmation because role-status evidence conflicts.
anomalies.immediate_action: Check an official source or direct confirmation before closing the journey.
anomalies.most_supported_explanation: A public status signal changed after earlier outreach.
anomalies.competing_explanations: The role may be temporarily hidden, reposted, or still active through another channel.
anomalies.preventive_action: Record both source timestamps and preserve the last confirmed state.
anomalies.verification: Close only after authoritative or direct evidence resolves the conflict.

actions.decision: Prepare for hiring-manager engagement and confirm scheduling.
actions.rationale: Recent confirmed stage advancement is the strongest active signal.

actions.decision: Resolve role-status contradiction before any progression claim.
actions.rationale: Conflicting evidence invalidates a clean health assessment.

actions.decision: Triage the 18 due-or-overdue follow-ups by engagement strength and priority.
actions.rationale: A dated queue converts staleness into a concrete operating action.

model_versions.description: Qualitative decision model grounded in tracker evidence and the Zero Trust sequence: verify provenance, determine journey target, assess health/risk, apply a decision rule, then verify the outcome.
model_versions.weight_changes: Direct stage advancement and direct contact outrank indirect interest; signals decay after seven days; unresolved contradictions block progression forecasts.
model_versions.evaluation_notes: Three forecasts opened; calibration is not scoreable until outcomes are recorded.

model_versions.description: Retrospective forecast replay using only the LinkedIn analytics and pipeline snapshot available at the maximum visibility signal: 2026-09-19 16:38 UTC.
model_versions.weight_changes: Freezes inputs at the peak timestamp; all later tracker events are treated only as outcomes or post-freeze evidence.
model_versions.evaluation_notes: One forecast hit inside its window; two remain open. Replay timing is disclosed and does not establish prospective accuracy.

indicators.name: Evidence freshness
indicators.definition: Share of active records with a last touch in the prior seven days.
indicators.decision_rule: Review the seven stale records before treating silence as a negative signal.

indicators.name: Median touch age
indicators.definition: Median days since the most recent recorded touch across 52 active records.
indicators.decision_rule: Prioritize records older than seven days, weighted by stage and engagement strength.

indicators.name: Direct evidence coverage
indicators.definition: Share of active records with a populated evidence-link field.
indicators.decision_rule: Do not assign high confidence to a record without a direct evidence object or authoritative source.

indicators.name: Action coverage
indicators.definition: Share of active records with a defined next action.
indicators.decision_rule: No record may remain active without an explicit act, monitor, investigate, or close decision.

indicators.name: Contradiction queue
indicators.definition: Active records requiring status confirmation because evidence conflicts.
indicators.decision_rule: Investigate before closing, advancing, or forecasting the affected journey.

indicators.name: Forecast verification
indicators.definition: Frozen forecasts with separately recorded outcomes.
indicators.decision_rule: One replay hit is visible, but calibration remains not yet scoreable until more prospective outcomes exist.

market_snapshot.title: Maximum LinkedIn signal peak
market_snapshot.partial_day_note: Sep 19 was a partial day. Premium began Sep 18, so incremental lift is not attributable from this snapshot.
market_snapshot.interpretation: A verified attention peak and a useful forecasting freeze point—not proof that content caused recruiter conversations, interviews, or offers.

heuristics.name: Verify provenance
heuristics.rule: User-confirmed or direct evidence outranks official ATS data; official ATS outranks public indexes; model inference never becomes observed fact.

heuristics.name: Determine journey state
heuristics.rule: Stage changes require an observed event. Interest, referrals, and outreach can increase priority but do not advance the stage alone.

heuristics.name: Apply recency decay
heuristics.rule: 0–3 days is current, 4–7 days is watch, 8–14 days is stale, and over 14 days requires explicit investigation or closure review.
heuristics.effect: Turns silence into an action trigger, not a rejection claim.

heuristics.name: Weight signal strength
heuristics.rule: Confirmed stage advancement and direct scheduling are Lighthouse-class; warm paths and public changes are supporting signals.
heuristics.effect: Focuses attention on events that change decisions.

heuristics.name: Penalize contradictions
heuristics.rule: Conflicting status, missing evidence, or unconfirmed application state blocks high-confidence progression forecasts.

heuristics.name: Freeze, verify, recalibrate
heuristics.rule: Forecasts are time-stamped before outcomes. Misses change only the next model version, never the original record.

zero_trust_translation.mechanism: Confirm who or what produced the signal and retain the source object.
Resolve the role family, current lifecycle state, and expected next event.
Combine stage, source reliability, recency, warm path, evidence coverage, and contradictions.
Act, monitor, investigate, close, or recalibrate based on visible thresholds.
Use end-to-end evidence rather than a single-point signal, inspired by ZDX visibility across device, path, and application.
Trigger on thresholds, preserve competing explanations, take action, and verify the result.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Confirmed stage advancement
lighthouse_candidates.why: One current journey has direct, user-confirmed stage advancement to hiring-manager handoff.
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Prepare, confirm scheduling, and open a near-term next-event forecast.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Warm or referral path
lighthouse_candidates.why: 44 of 52 active records include a warm-path or referral field, which changes prioritization but does not prove progression.
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Prioritize follow-up while preserving the observed stage.

lighthouse_candidates.name: Status contradiction
lighthouse_candidates.why: One active journey has conflicting role-status evidence and cannot be cleanly classified.
lighthouse_candidates.decision: Investigate before closing, advancing, or forecasting the journey.

synthetic_checks.name: Evidence freshness threshold
synthetic_checks.meaning: 45 of 52 records were touched within seven days; seven crossed the review threshold.

synthetic_checks.name: Follow-up checkpoint passed
synthetic_checks.meaning: Triage high-priority and direct-engagement records before lower-signal monitoring work.

synthetic_checks.name: Evidence sources disagree
synthetic_checks.meaning: One journey is held at investigate until an authoritative or direct source resolves status.

synthetic_checks.name: Forecast past due
synthetic_checks.meaning: Three forecasts are open; each has a future verification window and explicit change condition.

cadence.activity: Ingest and classify a new observation
cadence.control: Preserve source, timestamp, evidence state, and privacy before use
Resolve missing fields; never infer an observed event from silence
Examine threshold breaches, contradictions, and open decisions
Freeze the original forecast; write the outcome separately
Create a new model version with a documented reason

human_ai_loop.control: Retain the original evidence object and confidentiality flag
Record model version, task class, source IDs, and created time
Reject unsupported claims and preserve contradictions
Label model-produced output as derived or hypothesis
Approve, revise, or reject before a decision is recorded
Verify against an observed result and update only a new model version

limitations: The source tracker contains private job-search data. The public layer exposes only aggregates, generic role families, aliased organizations, stage dates, and evidence-quality flags; names, requisition IDs, contacts, notes, and private links remain excluded.
This is personal/process data, not production-service telemetry; CUJ, SLI, SLO, error-budget, and synthetic-monitoring concepts are used as careful analogies.

The forecast set is a retrospective replay frozen at the Sep 19 LinkedIn signal peak. It demonstrates the mechanism but must not be presented as a forecast that was prospectively recorded at that time.
One replay forecast hit its window; that single result is not statistically meaningful calibration or proof of predictive validity.
Correlation does not establish causation; competing explanations remain visible when evidence cannot resolve them.
LLM output cannot become observed fact without source evidence and human validation.
Portfolio mechanisms are user-provided, public-safe evidence; they are not independently audited by this page.

missing_data.value: Separates true forward prediction from retrospective replay and enables credible calibration.
Enables time-series baselines, anomaly detection, and lag analysis instead of a single peak comparison.
Would allow a defensible link between visibility, recruiter interaction, and stage progression.
Enables true signal-to-action latency and follow-up effectiveness measurement.
